title: Delegasi GSPP hadir sesi pendengaran pendapat nasihat berhubung isu Palestin di ICJ
description: Delegasi Gabungan Solidariti Pembebasan Palestin (GSPP) hadir bagi mengikuti sesi pendengaran pendapat nasihat (advisory opinion) Mahkamah Keadilan Antarabangsa (ICJ) di The Hague pada Isnin, menghujahkan isu pendudukan haram Israel di Palestin

title: Mahkamah benarkan permohonan MAINS batalkan saman pemula wanita tukar agama
description: Mahkamah Tinggi hari ini membenarkan permohonan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri Sembilan (MAINS) untuk membatalkan saman pemula difailkan seorang wanita bagi mengisytiharkannya sebagai bukan Islam.

title: Pengurusan hal-ehwal Islam tidak boleh ikut acuan bukan Islam
description: Hal-ehwal dan pengurusan berkaitan umat Islam di negara ini tidak boleh ditentukan mengikut acuan bukan Islam. Pada masa sama, segala urusan masyarakat bukan Islam perlu ditentukan oleh golongan itu sendiri tanpa campur tangan umat Islam.

title: Mahkamah batal saman pemula anak gali kubur bapa didakwa salah kebumi secara Islam
description: Mahkamah Tinggi, di sini, hari ini, membenarkan permohonan Kerajaan Negeri Sembilan dan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri Sembilan (MAINS) membatalkan saman pemula difailkan seorang lelaki untuk menggali kubur bapanya yang dikebumikan secara Islam, tujuh tahun lalu.

title: MAIPs mohon Mahkamah Persekutuan rayu kes pengislaman anak Siew Hong
description: Majlis Agama Islam dan Adat Istiadat Melayu Perlis (MAIPs) memohon kebenaran daripada Mahkamah Persekutuan untuk merayu keputusan Mahkamah Rayuan yang membatalkan pengislaman tiga anak ibu tunggal, Loh Siew Hong.

title: Tajaan syarikat arak: Bukan pasal politik semata-mata tetapi babitkan pendidikan dan kesihatan
description: Badan Peguam Syarie Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan menegaskan isu berkaitan sumbangan syarikat minuman keras di sekolah bukanlah bersifat politik atau keagamaan semata-mata, sebaliknya ia membabitkan isu pendidikan dan kesihatan.

title: Pertikaian harta RM2 bilion milik Jamaludin Jarjis selesai secara baik selepas 6 tahun
description: Kes tuntutan harta berjumlah lebih RM2 bilion dikemukakan balu Allahyarham Tan Sri Jamaludin Jarjis, Puan Sri Kalsom Ismail, terhadap empat anak dan ibu mentuanya sejak enam tahun lalu, berakhir hari ini.

title: JPSM baiki kelompangan pendakwaan syariah negara
description: Penubuhan Jabatan Pendakwaan Syarie Malaysia (JPSM) diharap dapat memperbaiki kelompangan dan mempertingkatkan kualiti pendakwaan dalam perundangan syariah di negara ini.

title: Pinda Perlembagaan Persekutuan untuk perbetul kepincangan, perjelas kuasa
description: Perbezaan ketara dari segi tafsiran peruntukan undang-undang jenayah Mahkamah Sivil dan Mahkamah Syariah mendorong wujudnya desakan supaya Perlembagaan Persekutuan dipinda bagi memberi penjelasan kuasa.

title: MAIWP, MAIJ dibenar jadi pencelah dalam saman Indira Ghandi
description: Mahkamah Tinggi di sini, hari ini, membenarkan permohonan Majlis Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan (MAIWP) dan Majlis Agama Islam Johor (MAIJ) untuk menjadi pencelah dalam saman pemula guru tadika M Indira Gandhi bagi mencabar enakmen negeri yang membenarkan penukaran agama kanak-kanak kepada Islam secara unilateral (sebelah pihak).

title: Hakim mahkamah syariah perlu bebas kongkongan
description: Hakim mahkamah syariah perlu dibebaskan daripada kongkongan sebagai penjawat awam, sebaliknya memerlukan status sama seperti hakim mahkamah sivil.

title: Tarik balik rayuan penggunaan kalimah Allah, kerajaan dituntut beri penjelasan penuh
description: Dua badan peguam syarie membantah keputusan kerajaan menarik balik rayuan di mahkamah berhubung penggunaan kalimah Allah oleh penganut bukan Islam.

title: Risiko terbesar beli tanah lot lidi
description: Pembeli tanah lot lidi terdedah kepada pelbagai kesan perundangan dengan risiko terbesar membawa mereka kepada kerugian, sekiranya pemegang amanah meninggal dunia.

title: Serina hilang hak jagaan kekal anak kedua
description: Pelakon Serina Redzuawan hilang hak penjagaan anak perempuannya, Isabella Saffiya O'luanaigh, 12, selepas diberikan kepada bekas suami, Gavin Edward O'luanaigh oleh Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah Shah Alam, minggu lalu.

title: Kebebasan asasi, hak asasi dua istilah berbeeza
description: Perlembagaan Malaysia tidak bersifat meminggirkan pihak tertentu meskipun ia tidak menyebut mengenai hak asasi manusia, sebaliknya kebebasan asasi.

title: Kes Iki Putra: 200 peguam gesa pindaan Perlembagaan
description: Seramai 200 peguam termasuk peguam bela, peguam cara dan peguam syarie menandatangani petisyen bagi mendesak pindaan Perlembagaan Persekutuan susulan kes Iki Putra Mubarak.

title: PPMM mohon jadi pencelah
description: Persatuan Peguam Muslim Malaysia (PPMM) akan mengemukakan permohonan untuk menjadi pencelah dalam kes saman difailkan peguam Syed Iskandar Syed Jaafar berhubung keputusan Yang di-Pertuan Agong kerana tidak mengisytiharkan darurat.

title: Sharnaaz, Nabila sepakat selesai tuntutan
description: Pelakon, Sharnaaz Ahmad dan bekas isteri, Noor Nabila mencapai kata sepakat dan bersetuju dengan tuntutan yang dimeterai dalam perjanjian penghakiman persetujuan di Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah di sini, hari ini.

title: Sheikh Ghazali ketuai Jawatankuasa Teknikal Syarak dan Sivil JAKIM
description: Bekas Ketua Pengarah/ Ketua Hakim Syarie, Jabatan Kehakiman Syariah Malaysia (JKSM), Tan Sri Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman dilantik Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Teknikal Undang-Undang Syarak dan Sivil, Jabatan Kemajuan Islam Malaysia (JAKIM) yang baharu.

title: Kenapa cabar hukuman lebih rendah mengikut undang-undang Islam?
description: Persatuan Peguam Muslim Malaysia (PPMM) mempersoalkan tindakan seorang lelaki mencabar keperlembagaan Seksyen 28 Enakmen Jenayah Syariah (Negeri Selangor) 1995 berhubung persetubuhan bertentangan dengan hukum tabii.

title: Kenapa cabar hukuman lebih rendah mengikut undang-undang Islam?
description: Persatuan Peguam Muslim Malaysia (PPMM) mempersoalkan tindakan seorang lelaki mencabar keperlembagaan Seksyen 28 Enakmen Jenayah Syariah (Negeri Selangor) 1995 berhubung persetubuhan bertentangan dengan hukum tabii.

title: Keputusan Jabatan Peguam Negara didakwa timbulkan 'contoh ikutan' berbahaya
description: Tindakan Jabatan Peguam Negara (AGC) membenarkan pendakwaan dihentikan terhadap 12 tertuduh yang menyokong kumpulan pengganas, Harimau Pembebasan Tamil Eelam (LTTE) didakwa menimbulkan ‘contoh ikutan’ berbahaya dalam pengendalian perbicaraan jenayah.

title: LTTE: Henti prosiding tanpa pertimbangan telus
description: Persatuan Peguam Muslim Malaysia mempertikai keputusan Jabatan Peguam Negara menghentikan prosiding undang-undang terhadap 12 lelaki warga tempatan yang berdepan tuduhan menyokong kumpulan pengganas, Harimau Pembebasan Tamil Eelam (LTTE).

title: Saya sudah tawar hati - Noor Nabila
description: Kakak Neelofa, Noor Nabila Mohd Noor, terkilan apabila suaminya, Sharnaaz Ahmad, 34, didakwa sengaja memanjangkan proses perceraian mereka.

title: MAIS bersyukur berjaya ketepikan permohonan SIS
description: Majlis Agama Islam Selangor (MAIS) melahirkan kesyukuran dengan keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur, hari ini, yang menolak permohonan pertubuhan Sister In Islam (SIS) untuk mencabar fatwa yang diwartakan Jawatankuasa Fatwa negeri ini.

title: Realiti kesalahan qazaf kes liwat
description: MAHKAMAH Syariah di negara ini perlu diperkasa semula bagi membolehkan kesalahan jenayah syariah ditangani lebih berkesan, selaras kehendak syarak.

title: Syazlin terus wakili keluarga arwah Adib
description: Peguam, Syazlin Mansor bertekad akan terus mewakili keluarga anggota bomba, Allahyarham Muhammad Adib Mohd Kassim, dalam prosiding inkues di Mahkamah Koroner yang bakal bersambung semula, pada 26 Jun ini.

title: PPMM minta penjelasan pelantikan Latheefa
description: Penjelasan perlu dibuat pihak berkuasa berhubung pelantikan peguam, Latheefa Koya sebagai Ketua Pesuruhjaya Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM) bagi mengelak isu itu berterusan dan kredibiliti kerajaan dipersoalkan.

title: Perlukah hukuman sebat dihapuskan?
description: HANYA Tuhan yang tahu betapa sakitnya disebat. Begitu luahan seorang banduan yang menerima 10 sebatan atas kesalahan jenayah dilakukan, sehingga beberapa minggu tidak dapat duduk seperti biasa.

title: Rujuk Perkara 125 Perlembagaan Persekutuan untuk selesai isu menari - PPMM
description: Tindakan Ketua Hakim Negara, Hakim Besar Sabah dan Sarawak serta Peguam Negara, menari di pentas di satu majlis rasmi didakwa boleh menimbulkan tohmahan terhadap mereka.

title: Bekas suami selebriti Serina bebas pertuduhan khalwat
description: Bekas suami seorang selebriti, Gavin Edward O’Luanaigh atau nama Islamnya Salahudin Ghaffar bebas daripada pertuduhan khalwat yang dikenakan terhadapnya oleh Mahkamah Rendah Syariah Subang Bistari, di sini.

title: Sekretariat Zenith senarai 8 tuntutan kepada UNHRC
description: Sekretariat Zenith yang dianggotai tiga pertubuhan bukan kerajaan (NGO) menggariskan lapan tuntutan yang akan diketengahkan dalam Majlis Hak Asasi Manusia Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu (UNHRC) yang akan berlangsung di Geneva, Switzerland, Khamis ini.

title: Rayuan ditolak, anak TYT Sarawak kekal bayar mutaah RM30j kepada bekas isteri
description: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah di sini mengekalkan keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah yang memerintahkan ahli perniagaan, Datuk Seri Mahmud Abu Bekir Taib membayar mutaah sebanyak RM30 juta kepada bekas isterinya, Shahnaz Abdul Majid.

title: Permohonan notis tunjuk sebab bekas suami Serena ditolak
description: Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah di sini hari ini menolak permohonan notis tunjuk sebab difailkan bekas suami selebriti, Serina Redzuawan berhubung pelanggaran perintah persetujuan bersama.

title: Appeals court overturns ruling allowing Maria Chin to challenge show-cause notice of contempt
description: The Court of Appeal today overturned a High Court decision that granted former Petaling Jaya Member of Parliament Maria Chin Abdullah (picture) leave to commence a judicial review to challenge a show-cause notice issued by the Syariah High Court for contempt.

title: Claim for matrimonial property by Jamaludin Jarjis’ widow resolved
description: The claim for matrimonial property valued at more than RM2 billion filed by Puan Sri Kalsom Ismail, who is the widow of Tan Sri Jamaludin Jarjis, against her four children and mother-in-law was settled amicably at the Syariah High Court here today.

title: SM Faisal fails in bid to intervene in Maria Chin’s judicial review application
description: Businessman Datuk SM Faisal SM Nasimuddin today failed in his bid to be an intervenor in the judicial review application by former Petaling Jaya Member of Parliament Maria Chin Abdullah.

title: MAIWP, MAIJ allowed to intervene in suit by Indira Ghandi on unilateral conversion
description: The High Court here today allowed the applications by the Federal Territory Islamic Religious Council (MAIWP) and the Johor Islamic Religious Council (MAIJ) to intervene in a suit filed by kindergarten teacher M. Indira Gandhi to challenge the state enactments that allows the unilateral conversion of children to Islam.

title: SIS Forum fails in appeal to quash fatwa labelling it deviant
description: Woman’s rights group SIS Forum (Malaysia) has lost its appeal in the Court of Appeal to quash a fatwa issued by the Selangor religious authorities labelling the company as deviant from the teachings of Islam.

title: Federal Court ruling opens floodgates
description: STATE religious authorities are urged to review its respective Shariah laws to prevent unfavourable court interpretation towards Shariah criminal offences going forward.

title: Question over AG’s early retirement
description: egal experts have questioned the validity of the government’s move to replace an attorney general (AG) who is heading an investigation into corrupt practices in 1Malaysia Development Bhd.

title: Appellate court overturns High Court's decision allowing Maria Chin to challenge contempt at Shariah Court
description: The Court of Appeal (COA) on Wednesday overturned a High Court decision two years ago that granted leave (permission) to former Petaling Jaya Member of Parliament Maria Chin Abdullah to challenge a show-cause issued by the Federal Territory Shariah High Court against her for contempt of court.

title: FT, Johor Islamic religious councils allowed to intervene in legal challenge of state unilateral conversion laws
description: The High Court has allowed Federal Territory Islamic Religious Council (MAIWP) and Johor Islamic Religious Council (MAIJ) to intervene in kindergarten teacher M Indira Gandhi and 13 others' legal action challenging the validity of state laws concerning unilateral conversion.

title: Court sets Aug 2 to hear Indira Gandhi's contempt bid against Kota Tinggi Islamic Council
description: The High Court on Monday (July 3) has fixed Aug 2 as the hearing date of the committal proceedings initiated by kindergarten teacher M Indira Gandhi and 13 others against the Kota Tinggi Islamic Council, which allegedly interfered in one of the plaintiffs’ application to challenge the validity of state laws concerning unilateral conversion to Islam.

title: Muslim NGOs question sudden withdrawal of govt’s appeal in Jill Ireland case
description: The Home Ministry and the government apparently withdrew their appeal in the Court of Appeal here last month in the case of Sarawakian clerk Jill Ireland’s judicial review of Christians being allowed to use the word “Allah” to refer to God.

title: High Court dismisses single mother's bid to reverse unilateral conversion of children to Islam
description: The High Court has dismissed single mother Loh Siew Hong's judicial review to challenge the unilateral conversion of her three children to Islam.

title: MAIPs seeks to recuse judge in case related to single mum Loh, decision on April 19
description: The Perlis Islamic Religious and Malay Customs Council (MAIPs) has sought to recuse High Court judge Evrol Mariette Peters from presiding over its application to intervene in the custody order given to single mother Loh Siew Hong.

title: Single mother Loh's ex-husband fined RM20,000 for contempt of court
description: Single mother Loh Siew Hong's former husband Muhammad Nagahswaran Muniandy was fined RM20,000 for contempt of court on Wednesday (April 5)

title: Sisters in Islam fails to challenge fatwa by Mais
description: Non-governmental organisation Sisters in Islam (SIS) has failed to challenge a fatwa by the Selangor Islamic council (MAIS) in 2014, which declared the organisation as promoting liberalism and pluralism, and is therefore considered as deviant.

title: High Court grants leave for mother to challenge unilateral conversion of children
description: The High Court here has granted leave to a Buddhist single mother to challenge the unilateral conversion of her three children by her Muslim-convert ex-husband.

title: Buddhist single mother to know on Aug 1 if able to challenge unilateral conversion of children
description: The High Court has set Aug 1 to deliver its decision on whether a Buddhist single mother can challenge the unilateral conversion of her three children by her Muslim-convert ex-husband.

title: Apex court: Selangor Syariah High Court has no judicial review powers
description: The Apex court on Monday (Feb 21) unanimously declared a Selangor Islamic Enactment which grants the state's Syariah High Court powers of judicial review as void.

title: Selangor fatwa declaring Sisters in Islam as a deviant group stands — High Court
description: The 2014 Selangor fatwa that declared Sisters in Islam (SIS) as a deviant organisation for subscribing to religious liberalism and pluralism still stands.

title: Group seeks blessings to help Hindus listed as Muslims
description: A group comprising Hindu organisations wants to set up an online registration system to assist those whose religious status is listed as Muslims against their will.

title: Muslim lawyers’ group ready to help conversion cases
description: Muslim Lawyers Association of Malaysia (PPMM) today expressed shock over claims made by a Hindu task force that some 7,000 people, mostly Hindus, were in a dilemma after being listed as Muslim.

title: Businessman’s ex-wife chose separation, say lawyers
description: Datuk Seri Mahmud Abu Bekir Abdul Taib’s lawyer questioned yesterday the basis for the businessman’s ex-wife, Shahnaz Majid, seeking a RM100 million muta’ah (conciliatory payment) claim.

title: RM100m suit against Taib Mahmud’s son, lawyers say ex-wife chose separation
description: Datuk Seri Mahmud Abu Bekir Abdul Taib's lawyer today questioned the basis for the businessman's ex-wife, Shahnaz Majid, seeking a RM100 million muta'ah (conciliatory payment) claim.

title: Jawi’s lawyer withdraws from Anwar suit
description: The Kuala Lumpur Syariah Court of Appeal has fixed April 27 for a decision on whether to accept lawyer Datuk Zainul Rijal Abu Bakar’s withdrawal from representing Datuk Seri Jamil Khir Baharom and two others cited in Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim’s qazaf (false accusation of sodomy) suit. The lawyer voluntarily recused himself from the case without informing Anwar’s lawyers, and had only submitted a notice on the matter yesterday morning.

title: Judge upset over Mahmud Bekir’s absence
description: A judge ticked off Datuk Seri Mahmud Abu Bekir Abdul Talib and his lawyer for their absence in the Syariah High Court yesterday in the suit by his ex-wife Shahnaz Majid for an RM100 million muta’ah claim. Judge Muhamad Abdul Karim Wahab said their actions had brought disrepute to the syariah courts at a time when they are being compared to the civil courts.

title: Madness in grossly high maintenance claims, says Datuk Seri Mahmud Abu Bekir Tai
description: Lawyers Zainul Rijal Abu Bakar and Saadiah Din acting in a child maintenance matter for Sarawak business entrepreneur Datuk Seri Mahmud Abu Bekir Taib today revealed that a RM121.4 million ‘Nafkah Anak’ (child maintenance) suit had been instituted by former wife Shahnaz Abdul Majid for their son Raden Murya Abdul Taib Mahmud.

title: #Update* Ibrahim Ali: Roman Catholic Church lawyers try to distort facts
description: Perkasa chief Datuk Ibrahim Ali has said that the arguments presented by the Roman Catholic Church (RCC) lawyers during the application for appeal over the word Allah at the Palace of Justice today were irrelevant.

title: De-register race-based parties and professional associations, says DAP chairman
description: It is time for all race- and religion-based political parties and professional associations to be de-registered in the interests of unity in Malaysia, DAP chairman Karpal Singh said yesterday.

title: #Update* Syariah court to hear objections against petition
description: The Federal Territories Syariah High Court has fixed March 10 to hear arguments on preliminary objections against Pakatan Rakyat leader Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim's bid to have his former aide Mohd Saiful Bukhari Azlan charged with making a false accusation (qazaf) of sodomy.

title: #Update* Syariah court to hear Anwar's 'qazaf' bid against Saiful on Feb 17
description: Opposition Leader Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim's bid to have his ex-aide Mohd Saiful Bukhari Azlan charged with making a false accusation (qazaf) of sodomy against the former will be rementioned on Feb 17.

title: Pindaan Akta 505: Peguam syarie bimbang mufti hilang punca kuasa
description: Seorang pengamal undang-undang syariah bimbang terhadap pindaan Rang Undang-undang (RUU) Pentadbiran Undang-undang Islam (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) atau Akta 505 yang meminda Fasal 10 dengan memansuhkan Bahagian III akta itu.

title: Lawyers’ group supports court’s decision to discharge, acquit Daim
description: A lawyers’ group has voiced support for the Kuala Lumpur sessions court’s decision to discharge and acquit former finance minister Daim Zainuddin of an asset disclosure charge following his death last week.

title: Lawyer slams academic’s call to replace religious minister, FT mufti
description: A prominent syariah lawyer has criticised an academic’s call to replace the religious affairs minister and the federal territories mufti in light of the controversy surrounding the Mufti (Federal Territories) Bill 2024.

title: Perlis fail permohonan semakan kembalikan status agama Islam anak Loh
description: Kerajaan Perlis memfailkan permohonan semakan di Mahkamah Persekutuan sebagai usaha mengembalikan status agama Islam tiga anak Loh Siew Hong, seorang ibu tunggal.

title: Zainul Rijal dipilih presiden pertama MPSWP
description: Peguam syarie, Zainul Rijal Abu Bakar dipilih sebagai Presiden Majlis Peguam Syarie Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan (MPSWP) bagi penggal pertama selama dua tahun (2022/2024).

title: Intervene in squabble over judge’s issue, Muslim lawyers tell Putrajaya
description: The Malaysian Muslim Lawyers Association has urged the government to intervene in a squabble among shariah officers on what should be done in the case of a top shariah judge accused of sexual harassment.

title: Penang religious body accused of delay tactics in wakaf land case
description: Lawyers acting for the family of a Penang real estate tycoon in the 1800s today slammed the Penang Islamic Religious Council (MAINPP) for allegedly employing stalling tactics by getting a new legal team midway through the hearing of the suit involving wakaf land.

title: Muhyiddin tak patut campur tangan kes Siti Kasim, kata peguam
description: Seorang peguam tidak bersetuju dengan gesaan agar Menteri Dalam Negeri Tan Sri Muhyiddin Yassin campur tangan dalam kes aktivis dan peguam Siti Kasim yang ditangkap susulan dakwaan beliau menculik anak guamnya dan menghalang pegawai polis menjalankan tugas.

title: Muslim lawyers body hits out at Bar for proposing Ambiga as AG
description: The Muslim Lawyers Association (PPMM) has opposed the Malaysian Bar’s suggestion that Ambiga Sreenevasan be made attorney-general (AG) by the new Pakatan Harapan (PH) government, calling it “poor judgement”.

title: Muslim lawyers group wants to assist in appointment of CJ case
description: The Muslim Lawyers Association wants to be a party in the legal challenge to nullify the appointments of the two most senior judges in the country as there are numerous ways of interpreting the Federal Constitution.

title: Mahkamah batal semakan kehakiman Hizbut Tahrir cabar fatwa sesat
description: Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah Shah Alam hari ini membatalkan permohonan semakan kehakiman oleh gerakan Hizbut Tahrir Malaysia untuk mencabar fatwa yang mengisytiharkannya menyeleweng daripada Islam.

title: DAP man defends marriage and divorce bill
description: Ipoh Barat MP M Kulasegaran has rejected the opinion that the bill to amend the Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act (LRA) infringes on the liberty of Muslims.

title: ‘Diyat’ option and the Federal Constitution
description: Introducing the Islamic provision for “diyat” as an alternative to the pardon of death row convicts will require a constitutional amendment, according to the president of the Muslim Lawyers Association, Zainul Rijal Abu Bakar.

title: Penjara khas untuk pesalah syariah, syor peguam Muslim
description: Penjara khusus untuk tahanan yang dibicarakan mengikut Mahkamah Syariah perlu diwujudkan bagi menjamin keberkesanan aspek pemulihan dan kebajikan mereka terbabit, syor Presiden Persatuan Peguam-peguam Muslim Malaysia, Datuk Zainul Rijal Abu Bakar.

title: Lawyer: Not true serving alcohol deters attendance at Bar events
description: A former member of the Malaysian Bar Council has denied assertions by certain lawyers behind a move to ban alcohol at the council’s functions that the presence of hard drinks is deterring non-drinkers from attending these events.

title: Arak punca kami keberatan hadir program, kata peguam Islam
description: Sebuah badan mewakili peguam Islam mempertahankan usaha seorang peguam membawa usul melarang arak dihidang pada acara tahunan Majlis Peguam, dengan berkata ia merupakan sebab ramai peguam beragama Islam keberatan hadir

title: Roneey: Kerajaan berhak, tapi jelaskan perubahan dasar – Peguam muslim
description: Putrajaya perlu menjelaskan mengapa rayuan keatas keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi dalam kes tukar agama Roneey Rebit bertukar arah secara tiba-tiba, kata Presiden Persatuan Peguam Muslim Malaysia, Zainul Rijal Abu Bakar.

title: Muslim legal group willing to help 7,000 converted Hindus
description: A Muslim legal group has offered to help 7,000 Hindus who were reported to have been wrongly registered as Muslims.

title: Sebatan di luar penjara ikut SOP - Zainul Rijal
description: Cara perlaksanaan sebatan di luar penjara ada perinciannya di dalam Prosedur Operasi Standard (SOP) Pelaksanaan Hukuman Sebatan di luar penjara yang telah dibuat oleh Jabatan Penjara bersama Kementerian Kesihatan.

title: Mahkamah batal saman pemula lelaki mohon gali semula kubur bapa
description: Mahkamah Tinggi di sini pada Jumaat membenarkan permohonan kerajaan negeri dan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri Sembilan (MAINS) untuk membatalkan saman pemula difailkan seorang lelaki untuk menggali semula kubur bapanya yang telah dikebumikan secara Islam tujuh tahun lalu.

title: Azlan Man perlu bayar nafkah idah bekas isteri RM12,850
description: Mahkamah Rendah Syariah Hulu Langat di sini pada Rabu, memerintahkan bekas Menteri Besar Perlis, Datuk Seri Azlan Man membayar nafkah idah kepada bekas isterinya, Sova Ali sebanyak RM12,850.

title: Mahkamah Rayuan ketepi kebenaran diperoleh Maria Chin untuk cabar notis tunjuk sebab
description: Mahkamah Rayuan hari ini mengetepikan keputusan Mahkamah Tinggi yang membenarkan bekas Ahli Parlimen Petaling, Maria Chin Abdullah memulakan semakan kehakiman bagi mencabar notis tunjuk sebab dikeluarkan oleh Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah.

title: Keputusan gali semula kubur bapa lelaki Hindu ditetapkan 20 Disember
description: Mahkamah Tinggi di sini pada Rabu menetapkan 20 Disember depan keputusan permohonan seorang lelaki beragama Hindu, Roseli Mahat untuk menggali semula kubur bapanya yang telah dikebumikan secara Islam tujuh tahun lalu.

title: Saranan tukar Menteri Agama: Hentikan tindakan menghasut, tanam kebencian - Musa
description: Semua pihak digesa untuk menghentikan tindakan menghasut atau menanam kebencian terhadap kedudukan Menteri Agama, mufti dan institusi yang bertanggungjawab bagi memastikan keagungan Islam di negara ini.

title: Perlis fail permohonan semakan untuk kembalikan status agama Islam anak Siew Hong
description: Kerajaan Perlis memfailkan permohonan semakan di Mahkamah Persekutuan sebagai usaha mengembalikan status agama Islam tiga anak ibu tunggal, Loh Siew Hong.

title: GISBH: Anak sah taraf dan wati' syubhah ada kesan perundangan berbeza
description: Kategori anak sah taraf, tak sah taraf atau wati’ syubhah mempunyai ramifikasi perundangan yang berbeza dalam hukum syarak.

title: Guan Eng diingatkan tidak politikkan isu sumbangan syarikat arak
description: Pengerusi DAP, Lim Guan Eng diingatkan agar tidak mempolitikkan isu sumbangan syarikat arak di sekolah vernakular apabila menempelak Menteri Pendidikan, Fadhlina Sidek supaya tidak mengikut telunjuk Pas.

title: Tuntutan harta lebih RM2.1 bilion Jamaludin Jarjis selesai
description: Selepas enam tahun berlanjutan, balu Allahyarham Tan Sri Dr Jamaludin Jarjis, Puan Sri Dr Kalsom Ismail bersama empat anak dan ibu mentuanya akhirnya bersetuju untuk menyelesaikan kemelut tuntutan harta sepencarian lebih RM2.1 bilion secara baik, di Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah Wilayah Persekutuan di sini pada Rabu.

title: Jawatankuasa Khas Pertahan Enakmen Syariah Kelantan bersidang selepas Mei
description: Jawatankuasa Khas Pertahan Enakmen Syariah Kelantan dijangka kali pertama bersidang selepas Mei ini.

title: Mahkamah batal saman pemula wanita terhadap MAINS
description: Mahkamah Tinggi di sini membenarkan permohonan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri Sembilan (MAINS) untuk membatalkan saman pemula difailkan seorang wanita bagi mengisytiharkannya sebagai bukan beragama Islam.

title: Langkah penting buat rakyat Palestin
description: Kenyataan lisan Malaysia dalam sesi pendengaran awam Pendapat Nasihat melalui Mahkamah Keadilan Antarabangsa (ICJ) berhubung isu Palestin boleh digunakan sebagai prosiding di mesyuarat Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu (PBB).
